entities.summary: The Riga—Lugaži Railway is a 166 kilometres (103 mi) long, 1,524 mm gauge railway in Latvia. It was built in the late 19th century to connect the cities of Riga and Saint Petersburg via Valga and Pskov. The railway was opened in 1889.
